headline: Approved minutes, a handicap parking space, and reviewed ongoing golf and tennis facility projects.
summary: The Golf and Tennis Commission approved the December 9, 2025 minutes and reviewed updates on several facility projects, including tennis court water pipes, the Veranda awning, fence and tree work near Elliott St., and restroom renovations. The commission also approved adding a handicap parking space near the pro shop and heard updates on the Renick Family Memorial project and 2025 membership numbers.
decisions: Approved adding one handicap parking space next to the path to the pro shop, 5-0.
